text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. Not on any regular medications. Social history: Non-smoker. Drinks alcohol socially. Works as a high school teacher. No recent travel or sick contacts.

speaker: Doctor
text: The timing of your faint immediately after urination is highly suggestive of micturition syncope, especially given your lack of prior medical history and medications. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope.

The history of syncope occurring immediately after voiding in a 53-year-old male, combined with a rapid return to consciousness, a lack of neurological deficits, and a normal ECG strongly supports this diagnosis. I do not require further testing at this time.
